required_facts_checked.claim: The FAQ assistant runs for DataTalks.Club students and was moved toward Au-Tomator's AWS infrastructure.
required_facts_checked.evidence: source opening and AWS Lambda deployment

required_facts_checked.claim: ZoomcampQABot was developed by Alex Litvinov and used Fly.io, Milvus/Zilliz, Cohere, HuggingFace, Redis, and ingestion jobs.
FAQ data moved from frequently vandalized Google Docs to Markdown in DataTalksClub/faq.
Questions come from GitHub, Slack, and YouTube transcripts.
GitHub Actions uses minsearch and OpenAI to classify NEW, UPDATE, DUPLICATE, or WRONG_COURSE.
Evaluation uses leave-one-out for historical NEW cases and has 61 decision cases.
Zerosearch replaced minsearch for a pure-Python Lambda-friendly deployment, and the index is about 8 MB.
required_facts_checked.evidence: source zero-dependency search and index size

required_facts_checked.claim: Retrieval evaluation used 9,900 Slack threads and 130 questions with hit rate and MRR at k=1,3,5.
Query rewriting preserves exact errors, tool names, commands, and filenames.
Au-Tomator routes mentions and :faq: reactions to the FAQ Lambda, and incorrect answers feed future evaluation and records.

substantive_edits: Kept Alex Litvinov's authorship of ZoomcampQABot separate from Alexey's takeover and redesign.
Restored the migration motive, classification decisions, leave-one-out qualification, Lambda dependency constraint, index size, and evaluation counts.
Separated curation, deployment, retrieval evaluation, and Au-Tomator routing so the data loop remains clear.
